تحتفرون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِرُونَ (taḥtafirūna) /taħ.ta.fi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# تُحْتَفَرُونَ (tuḥtafarūna) /tuħ.ta.fa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
